In this paper, **BA** stands for **4-mercaptophenylboronic acid**, also abbreviated **4-MPBA**.

- **Definition:** The positively charged L-type helical gold nanorods are "functionalized with 4-mercaptophenylboronic acid (4-MPBA, BA) to form BA@L-HGNRs recognition probes" (page 2). The abstract also calls the probe "4-mercaptophenylboronic acid-functionalized L-type intrinsically helical gold nanorods (BA@L-HGNRs)" (page 1).
- **Its role:** The boronic acid groups form dynamic covalent bonds with cis-diol groups on bacterial surfaces. Together with electrostatic attraction, this anchors the probes to the bacteria and suppresses NaCl-induced aggregation (pages 2 and 4).
- **Optimised concentration:** A 4-MPBA concentration of 165 μM was chosen for all subsequent experiments (page 4).
